assertions.assertion: Protected reference-only UpdateFirmware sends the provider location with the caller's retrieveDate, retries and retryInterval; the empty conf is acknowledgement only and never proof of installation.

Every legacy FirmwareStatusNotification is committed before its empty reply and advances the newest unresolved legacy job phase-monotonically; Idle is a triggered not-busy report that resolves the job without claiming success.

SignedUpdateFirmware always carries the provider's signing certificate and signature; the bridge verifies the certificate chain under the manufacturer root before sending, and an independent station verifies RSA-PSS SHA-256 over the whole image.
Signed notifications advance only the job with their exact requestId; a missing requestId is accepted only for Idle; all fourteen statuses decode and regressions are counted, not applied.
Each station has exactly one firmware family; NotSupported CALLERROR, Rejected, InvalidCertificate and RevokedCertificate are preserved as native refusals that release the drain.
AcceptedCanceled cancels the previous unresolved signed job; Rejected keeps it; later reports for a cancelled job never revive it.
Delayed download/installation and reboot statuses are reported against the trusted job deadline; a deadline only times the job out and never resolves the release drain.
Lost replies stay uncertain and are never replayed after restart or reconnect; later native reports still resolve the job, and only resolved jobs release the drain.

not_covered: SecurityEventNotification for InvalidFirmwareSigningCertificate, InvalidFirmwareSignature and FirmwareUpdated (L01.FR.02/03/33, issue #127)
